Catalog.heading: Small workshops where you learn by doing.

Home.title: WorkshopOS
Home.subtitle: An AI-first, bilingual platform for running a workshop business — built under human approval.
Home.sampleBody: Space is the primary layout tool; density is earned, never default. Hairline rules organize content instead of boxes and shadows. One accent color, used sparingly and precisely.
